name: Parent Child Relationship
overview: Scripture emphasizes the sacred responsibility within the parent-child relationship, calling children to honor and obey their parents as a reflection of their commitment to God (Exodus 20:12; Proverbs 1:8). It also underscores the necessity of loving discipline, where correction is an expression of care aimed at guiding children away from foolishness and rebellion (Deuteronomy 21:18; Proverbs 13:24; Proverbs 22:15). Furthermore, consistent training in the ways of the Lord is vital, promising that a child taught faithfully will maintain that godly path throughout life (Proverbs 22:6).
